request.question: Which classes define the most methods? Give the top five.
request.evidence: A method's qualname is its class's qualname followed by a dot and the method name.

events.thought: I will rank class symbols by how many method symbols they define. The evidence rule is applied by matching a method to a class when the method's qualified name equals the class's qualified name, followed by a dot, followed by the method's bare name. I also require the class and method to be in the same file, because qualified names are only unique within a module and omitting this could incorrectly match same-named classes across files. I use an inner join, so classes with zero methods are excluded; this is appropriate because the question asks for the classes with the most methods. I count non-null method symbol IDs. Ties are broken alphabetically by class qualified name, then by class symbol ID for deterministic ordering.

gold_sql:
SELECT c.symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS methods
FROM code.symbols c
JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.kind = 'method'
  AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.' || m.name
WHERE c.kind = 'class'
GROUP BY c.symbol_id
ORDER BY methods DESC, c.symbol_id
LIMIT 5;
